subject: Tufts Mutual Aid COVID-19 Response
overview: Host Anna Callahan spoke with Tufts Mutual Aid organizers Nikhil and Madeline about student relief efforts following the sudden COVID-19 campus closure. The group detailed their academic policy advocacy, food pantry operations, and efforts to assist displaced students.

items.title: Introduction to Tufts Mutual Aid
items.summary: Organizers explained that Tufts Mutual Aid formed quickly after the university's COVID-19 shutdown to connect students in need with essential resources.

items.title: Impact of Sudden Campus Evacuation
items.summary: Organizers described the logistical and emotional hardships students faced after being given under a week's notice to vacate campus.

items.title: Advocacy for Academic Policy Changes
items.summary: Nikhil detailed proposals submitted to university deans urging asynchronous learning, relaxed attendance policies, and alternative assessment methods.

items.title: Establishment of On-Campus Food Pantry
items.summary: Madeline explained how the group established an on-campus food pantry using donated food from departing students and university support.

items.title: Community Support and Outreach
items.summary: Organizers discussed expanding local community partnerships and directed supporters to connect via their Facebook page.
